name: Nancy Wu
shortBio: Program manager for Proud Tek's industrial-laundry RFID business; technical reviewer on PPS / silicone / textile tag durability and ISO 6330 wash-cycle testing.
bio: Nancy Wu manages Proud Tek's industrial-laundry RFID program. She is the named technical reviewer on /about/review-board/ for articles covering PPS / silicone / textile tag durability and ISO 6330 wash-cycle testing. In that role she co-signs every laundry-tag article that cites a wash-cycle count, a tunnel-washer specification, or an installation-cost claim, and is the point of contact for hospitality customers running pilot deployments in Proud Tek's Shenzhen test facility. Nancy holds a Bachelor's degree in English from North Minzu University (Yinchuan, China). Her byline is backed by operational ownership of the laundry program; technical-standards claims in articles she reviews are verified against the issuing standard (ISO 6330, ISO/IEC 18000-63) and cited in each article's sources block.
expertise: PPS / silicone / textile tag selection under ISO 6330 wash-cycle durability testing
credentials: B.A. in English, North Minzu University (Yinchuan, China)
